summary: Validate every indexed BTC rule interval before resuming the indexer
details: Startup now rejects persisted history containing an unsupported intermediate rule interval, even when the origin and final height use supported versions. This check runs before rules binding and snapshot-history cursor reconciliation.
An immutable registry timeline supplies supported block contexts, interval inspection and historical-prefix comparison without changing existing registry or active-version-set identities.

Production still supports mint schema v1, MinerPass state machine v2 and the current v1 formulas. This foundation does not enable new rule versions, cross-version settlement, RPC history reuse or in-place dataset registry upgrades.
